triples.rationale: Obadiah moves from drinking on the holy mountain to the nations drinking and going down. In the Jeremiah account, the nations receive the Lord's wine cup of judgment, with Jerusalem and Judah heading the listed recipients. Both connect the city's judgment with that of the nations; Jeremiah explicitly names the cup.
triples.source_text: For just as you drank on My holy mountain, all the nations will drink wine; they will drink and go down, and they will be as though they did not exist.

target_units.text: Thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: Take this cup of unmixed wine from My hand, and give it to all the nations to whom I send you to drink,
and they will drink, vomit, and go mad before the sword I am sending among them.
And I took the cup from the Lord’s hand and gave it to the nations to whom the Lord sent me to drink:
Jerusalem, Judah’s cities, Judah’s kings, and its rulers, to make them a desolation, an untrodden place, and a hissing;
